name: team-rules
description: agile-team-kit hard rules from team/TEAM.md that the built-in rules don't cover: main belongs to the owner and only the owner merges PRs.
author: agile-team-kit

rules.name: block-push-to-main
rules.reason: main belongs to the owner (team/TEAM.md). Push to develop, team-state or a ticket branch and open a PR.

rules.name: block-pr-merge
rules.reason: Only the owner merges PRs into main; the integrator merges into develop with git (team/TEAM.md).

rules.name: block-repo-delete
rules.reason: Deleting a repository is never part of a team run.
